sentence: Contrastive decoding (Li et al., 2022) aims to improve text quality by contrasting token predictions from an expert and amateur model, with the intent of maximizing expert-like generations while minimizing amateur-like text. (Su et al., 2022) introduces contrastive search decoding, which augments top-k with an additional degeneration penalty hyperparameter  $ \alpha $ that balances the candidate token confidence with greater dissimilarity between the previous context and the context continuation using the token. (Arias et al., 2024) advances this strategy through examining local variations in the entropy to determine the top-k and degeneration penalty hyperparameters, thereby improving robustness across diverse contexts.
